page.title: Quality and holds
page.description: Units on hold or in quarantine, failed and inconclusive lab results, and open incidents. A failed result or a critical incident places the unit on hold automatically.
page.searchPlaceholder: Unit, reason, analyte, laboratory or incident title

stats.holdsHint: {count, plural, one {# in quarantine} other {# in quarantine}}
stats.testsHint: {count, plural, one {# more is inconclusive} other {# more are inconclusive}}
stats.incidentsHint: {count, plural, one {# is critical} other {# are critical}}

page.noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear it to see everything.

holds.title: Units on hold
holds.caption: Units on quality hold or in quarantine
holds.releaseReason: Why is it safe to release?
holds.releaseBody: The unit can be moved, derived, shipped and destroyed again. Your reason and your name are recorded. You may be asked to confirm your password.
holds.emptyBody: A unit appears here when it is placed on hold or in quarantine, by a person or by a failed result.

tests.title: Failed and inconclusive lab results
tests.caption: Failed and inconclusive lab results
tests.voidBody: The result is withdrawn with your reason and stops counting. It stays in the audit trail. A hold it caused is not released automatically.
tests.emptyBody: Results are recorded from a unit page. Only failed and inconclusive ones are listed here.

incidents.title: Open incidents
incidents.caption: Open quality incidents
incidents.voidBody: The incident is withdrawn with your reason. It stays in the audit trail. This cannot be undone.
incidents.emptyBody: Open an incident when something goes wrong with material, a process or a record.

picker.none: No unit found. Check the spelling, or try a shorter part of the name.
picker.found: {count, plural, one {# unit found} other {# units found}}

incidentForm.dialogDescription: Describe what happened. A critical incident on a unit in inventory places that unit on hold.
incidentForm.title: Title
incidentForm.titleRequired: Give the incident a short title.
incidentForm.severityHint: Critical places a linked unit on hold.
incidentForm.linkedFixed: This incident is linked to unit {name}.
incidentForm.descriptionHint: What happened, who found it, and the immediate containment.
incidentForm.autoHeld: The linked unit was placed on hold automatically.

placeHold.title: Place a unit on hold
placeHold.description: A hold stops moving, deriving, changing stage, shipping and destroying the unit until an administrator releases it.
placeHold.unitHint: Search by unit name. Units already on hold or out of inventory are not listed.
placeHold.kindHint: Quarantine is for suspected contamination or disease.
placeHold.reasonHint: At least {count} characters. This is kept in the audit trail.
placeHold.reasonShort: Explain the reason in at least {count} characters.

updateIncident.title: Update the incident
updateIncident.resolutionHint: Required to close an incident, at least {count} characters.
updateIncident.resolutionShort: Describe the resolution in at least {count} characters.
